title: Setup record pages (sys_organization and the other sys_* records) drop the Discussion feed and the floating Identity chip
body:
## Source

Walked on objectui main `8415d9f11`, `/apps/com.objectstack.setup/sys_organization/record/org_ms2og4kvotaa6u3b`: the record page is the generic business-record page — title "Default Organization" with an "Organization" chip and a copy icon, Edit / ⋯ / Refresh, Slug, tabs Members (1) · Invitations · Teams, the Members table, then a "Discussion (0)" section with an "All Activity" filter and a comment composer ("Leave a comment… (Ctrl+Enter to submit)"), and a yellow "Identity" chip floating at the top-right of the content area. A settings record has no readers for a comment thread; the chip duplicates the header's kind chip.

## Target

1. System objects (`sys_*` rendered inside Setup) declare `enable.feeds = false` or the detail page checks the object's posture and renders no Discussion section; the activity timeline stays where the object enables it.
2. The floating kind chip retires on Setup record pages; the kind stays in the page header's chip.
3. The header's copy-id icon stays; Edit and ⋯ keep their actions.

## File surface

`packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailView.tsx` (section composition by object posture), `packages/plugin-detail/src/RecordComments*`, the platform objects' `enable` flags where the console reads them (`sys_organization`, `sys_team`, `sys_business_unit`, `sys_user`), tests beside each.

## Acceptance

1. Tests: a `sys_organization` record renders no comment composer; a business object with feeds enabled still does.
2. Screenshot at 1280 px, light and dark.
3. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-detail test` green.

## Constraints

- If the posture must come from objectstack-ai/objectstack's object definitions (`enable.feeds`), the card reports it and files the flag change there; the console change still lands reading the flag.

## Evidence

Screenshots on the temporary branch `claude/console-home-login-design-20261016` of objectstack-ai/objectui (commit `01244b886`, never merged): [setup-organization-record-small.jpg](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/01244b886/docs/design/setup-review-2026-10-16/setup-organization-record-small.jpg?raw=true).

<sub>Filed by the epic PM session `session_cdb7a717-def7-4e71-9988-f089fbaa18ff` from the 2026-10-16 second review pass: objectui main `8415d9f11`, HotCRM `63db83e2`, the vite console on :5180 against `objectstack serve --dev` on :4001, the Studio pillars and all 43 Setup pages walked in the maintainer's browser pane at 1024 × 768 (en) with a 1280 × 900 re-check (zh). The maintainer asked for every finding to be filed, verbatim: 「全部立卡」.</sub>
